Shield automatically forgives one false prize claim. It can protect each ticket once per round. Without an available Shield, a false claim discards only that ticket; earlier wins remain valid.
Tap Auto-Dab to catch up on a ticket and mark new calls for 35 seconds. Automatic marks do not earn powers.
Tap: +25%% on the next win for Ticket %1$d
Arm a 25% bonus on one ticket before claiming. Its next successful prize earns extra virtual coins after the final pool split, rounded down. Use once per ticket. Other winners keep their full share.

Every five new correct manual marks across your tickets earns one free Auto-Dab or Prize Boost. Hold at most two. A full inventory skips that drop. Powers expire with the round. Wrong taps are rejected. Late and duplicate claims do not discard tickets. Older tables may still contain Shield. No cash value.
Mark 5 called numbers to earn Auto-Dab or a prize boost.
No powers. False claims receive a warning; all tickets stay in play.
Practice personas are simulated opponents. Friends tables contain invited players only.
